MicroTask.title: MicroTask
MicroTask.description: A task broken down into low-friction 2-minute micro-steps with avoidance blocker analysis and dread rating.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner matching request.auth.uid.

title.description: Title of the task (1 to 200 characters).

blockerType.description: Root emotional/cognitive reason for procrastinating on this task.

dreadLevel.description: Perceived dread/anxiety level before starting (1 to 10).

microSteps.description: List of up to 20 tiny actionable micro-steps (strings up to 200 chars).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the task; locked once completed.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ThoughtLog.title: ThoughtLog
ThoughtLog.description: A CBT cognitive reframing entry capturing an anxious thought, cognitive distortion, compassionate reframe, tiny action, and pre/post anxiety ratings.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner matching request.auth.uid.

anxiousThought.description: The raw anxious or catastrophic thought (1 to 500 characters).

distortion.description: Identified cognitive distortion label (1 to 60 characters).

reframeText.description: Grounded, evidence-based compassionate reframe (1 to 500 characters).

tinyAction.description: One tiny 2-minute controllable step (1 to 200 characters).

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FocusSession.title: FocusSession
FocusSession.description: An immutable completed anti-procrastination focus timer session.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner matching request.auth.uid.

modeName.description: Focus timer mode name (1 to 80 characters).

taskTitle.description: Title of the task worked on (1 to 200 characters).

createdAt.description: Session completion server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WorryVaultItem.title: WorryVaultItem
WorryVaultItem.description: An intrusive worry postponed to a scheduled Worry Window.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner matching request.auth.uid.

worryText.description: Text of the postponed worry (1 to 500 characters).

scheduledWindow.description: Scheduled worry window label (1 to 120 characters).

isResolved.description: Whether the worry has been resolved or faded.

MpesaSubscription.title: MpesaSubscription
MpesaSubscription.description: A verified M-Pesa subscription record sent to recipient 0119137126.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated subscriber matching request.auth.uid.

planTitle.description: Display name of the subscribed tier (1 to 100 characters).

amountKes.description: Subscription price paid in Kenyan Shillings (KES).

senderPhone.description: Subscriber's M-Pesa phone number (1 to 24 characters).

mpesaReceiptCode.description: Alphanumeric M-Pesa confirmation code (8 to 12 characters).

/users/{userId}/thought_logs/{logId}.description: Per-user collection of CBT cognitive reframing logs.

/users/{userId}/focus_sessions/{sessionI.description: Per-user append-only collection of completed focus timer sessions.

/users/{userId}/subscriptions/{subscript.description: Per-user collection of M-Pesa subscription receipts.
